name: Corinna
beschreibung:
Peacefully situated in Ischgl, Haus Corinna provides an ideal base for skiers and mountain lovers. Its well-kept accommodations feature modern conveniences and ensure restful nights after active days outdoors.

Lifts to the famous Silvretta Arena and the lively town centre are within easy reach, keeping world-class slopes and entertainment close at hand.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Corinna in Ischgl provides cosy rooms and apartments with direct access to Tyrol's most celebrated ski arena.
